Subject: Severe latency/errors this morning — immediate help needed

Aisha / Karthik,

We saw a major surge starting ~06:30 PDT that spiked tail latency ~20x and pushed error rates on our generate and embedding endpoints to ~5% for roughly 40 minutes. Traffic is normal but token-level latencies shot up and several critical checkout flows timed out. Attached a couple of screenshots and a short aggregation of 95/99/99.9 metrics.

Can you confirm you have an on-call bridge? We need: 1) quick mitigation so our storefront stabilizes, 2) an RCA, and 3) timeline for fix/mitigation. This is impacting a weekend promotion — execs are watching.

Attachments: screenshot_latencies.png

Thanks,

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-29T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Initial RCA (draft) — Solaris Retail surge 2027-09-29

Marcus / Aisha / Team — posting initial findings from the bridge and quick triage. This is a draft; we’ll produce a formal PDF RCA by EOD. Attachment: initial_rca.md and telemetry_export.tar.gz.

Summary (short):
- Impact window: 06:28 – 07:12 PDT (observed at ingress).
- Symptoms: elevated p95/p99 token latency, increase in 5xxs concentrated on quantized embedding models behind the embedding endpoint, sporadic KV cache misses for prefix reuse.
- Root cause (candidate): a scheduler regression that distributed one of the embedding model variants onto a host family with an incompatible kernel-module path for the quantized runtime. That triggered slower operator fallbacks and a burst of cache invalidations. Autocalled autoscaler logic interpreted the latency spike as load and began aggressive scaling which magnified cold-start overhead for remaining requests.

Immediate mitigations applied during bridge:
1) Manual rollback of embedding model variant to v1.2 (pre-quant change) — reduces tail latency immediately.
2) Manual pinning of affected pods to the known-good host pool.
3) Disabled the aggressive autoscaler override rule for the service.

Next steps (corrective, short):
- Create a corrective sprint to fix scheduler validation + add pre-deploy runtime checks. Owner: Marissa Cole. ETA: 4 weeks.
- Harden cache warmup and add a pre-scale KV population job. Owner: Karthik Iyer. ETA: 2 weeks for initial instrumentation.
- Postmortem doc + RCA PDF by EOD (will include timelines and telemetry cut).

Notes: telemetry_export.tar.gz contains 1-min aggregates, kube events, and runtime logs for the affected nodes.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
SRE, Serving Runtime, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-09-29T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Corrective sprint plan & ticket roster (Solaris Retail)

Team — attached is a one-page corrective sprint plan and owner roster (corrective_sprint_plan.xlsx). High level: four-week focused sprint with two parallel tracks (scheduler/runtime validation and cache/warmup improvements). I’ve opened the following JIRA tickets and linked them to SR-4532:
- SR-4532-1: Scheduler pre-deploy validation + kernel compatibility checks — Owner: Marissa Cole — 2 weeks to functional test.
- SR-4532-2: Pre-scale KV warmup job and instrumentation — Owner: Karthik Iyer — 10 business days for telemetry + smoke tests.
- SR-4532-3: Autoscaler safe-mode + hysteresis tuning — Owner: David Kim — 1 week to stage rollout.
- SR-4532-4: Customer comms + credits draft — Owner: Aisha Rahman — 48 hours.

Customer-facing plan for Solaris (for Marcus): we propose a short-term stability patch (rollback already applied), then a staged corrective rollout with observability gates. We recommend a partial credit against the impacted weekend window; Kimberly, can you advise on banding and approval?

I’ll own cadence and weekly delivery reports to execs. Please review the spreadsheet and confirm owners/times. I’ll kick off the sprint on Monday pending exec approval.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Site Reliability Programs, Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>

Approvals requested:
- Approve 4-week corrective sprint and transient infra spend up to $15k.
- Approve customer credit framework (Aisha/Kimberly to finalize) for impacted weekend window.

If we get exec signoff today we’ll start the sprint Monday and target a first checkpoint with Solaris execs next Friday.

—David
